niches.new-gen-underground-rap: You heard it on a leak before it hit Spotify, and you will tell everyone.
niches.rage: Your resting heart rate is a synth lead. Earplugs are for other people.
niches.jerk: Piano loop, blown-out 808, and you're already bouncing. Can't help it.
niches.soundcloud-rap: Part of you still lives in 2017, red dreads and all. Respect.
niches.plugg: You like your beats spacious and your synths twinkly. Very save-screen core.
niches.pluggnb: Plugg drums, R&B feelings. You've definitely sent a 3am text to this.
niches.dark-plugg: You found plugg and turned the lights off. The 808 is screaming and so are you.
niches.tread: Anything under 160 BPM feels like a nap to you.
niches.cloud-rap: Hazy, reverb-soaked and a little sad. Your walks home are cinematic.
niches.experimental-rap: If a song makes sense on first listen, you've already skipped it.
niches.trap: The 808 is the main character and you're the narrator.
niches.digicore: Made on Discord, mixed on a laptop, cried about in the group chat.
niches.sigilkore: Occult symbols, Memphis samples, infinite reverb. Your cover art has a sigil.
niches.glitchcore: Your edits have 40 transitions and every one of them slaps.
niches.deftones-core: White Pony is a comfort album and your hoodie is load-bearing.
niches.nu-gaze: You need your riffs heavy and your vocals buried in fog.
niches.vamp: All black, leather flares, silver on every finger. You might sleep in a coffin.
niches.graphic-gothic-streetwear: Tribal print long sleeve, a cross on everything, zero subtlety.
niches.dark-streetwear: Every piece you own is black and somehow they're all different.
niches.dark-avant-garde: Draped, deconstructed and a little monastic. Your boots cost more than rent.
niches.archive-fashion: It's not used, it's from the 2002 runway, actually.
niches.underground-graphic-streetwear: Your fit is the drop, and the drop sold out in four minutes.
niches.diy-reworked: Why buy it distressed when you can destroy it yourself?
niches.mcbling-revival: Velour, rhinestones and paparazzi energy. Zero irony, all sparkle.
niches.underground-sneaker-culture: If people have heard of your shoes, you're already over them.
niches.underground-rap: Your favorite rapper's favorite rapper's favorite rapper lives in your headphones.
niches.gorpcore: Dressed for a summit, headed to the bodega.
niches.dark-academia: You've never finished the reading but you own three editions of it.
niches.y2k: The year 2000 called and you picked up immediately.
niches.indie-sleaze: Flash photography, skinny jeans, one more song and then we leave (we don't).
niches.cottagecore: You'd rather be baking bread in a meadow, and honestly, valid.
niches.midwest-emo: Twinkly guitars and feelings you'll process in a basement show.
niches.skater: Scabs, Thrasher and a VHS camera. Your knees have stories.
niches.f1: You know tyre strategy better than your own schedule.
niches.k-pop: You know the choreo, the comeback date and the lightstick model.
niches.techwear: Every jacket has eleven pockets and you use all of them.
niches.coquette: Bows on everything. Soft, pink and slightly devastating.
niches.grunge: Flannel, fuzz and a deep need to be left alone.
niches.sneakerheads: Your closet is a shoe wall and your phone is full of release alarms.
niches.anime: You judge a show by its opening and you're always right.
niches.lo-fi: Beats to study to, and you have never studied once.
niches.gym-rat: Phonk in your ears, PRs on your mind, rest day is a myth.
niches.hyperpop: Maximal everything. Your playlist sounds like a sugar rush.
niches.goth: Black lace, velvet and a playlist that's mostly The Cure.
niches.jersey-club: Bed squeaks, chopped samples and footwork you can't stop.
niches.shoegaze: The vocals are in there somewhere. You're fine with that.
niches.afrobeats: Log drums and good energy: you're always the reason the party starts.
niches.cyberpunk: Neon rain, chrome and a soft spot for dystopia.
niches.vaporwave: Mall music from a future that never happened.
niches.city-pop: Sunset drives in Tokyo, 1984, in your head.
niches.coastal-cowboy: Boots on the boardwalk. Yeehaw, but make it beachy.
niches.bedroom-pop: Recorded in your room, felt in everyone's.
niches.blokecore: Retro football kits and terrace chants as a lifestyle.
niches.rave: 4am, strobe lights, a bottle of water and zero regrets.

combos.text: You don't just listen to rage, you dress for it. Opium would approve.
The music and the wardrobe match perfectly. Very YVL of you.
Plugg by day, pluggnb after midnight. A balanced diet.
Drain Gang on the headphones, runway lore in the closet.
You're the reason the Deftones revival happened, honestly.
You live where the internet makes music. Pitched-up and proud.
Chrome and rhinestones: you're the whole 2000s in one fit.
Your wardrobe is basically a museum with a Rick Owens wing.
Rage in the pit, jerk on the walk home. The full underground diet.
Maximum saturation, maximum BPM. Your screen time is iconic.
